title: heliotropium fumana
intro: Heliotropium fumana, commonly known as False Fumitory or Fumana, is a plant species in the borage family (Boraginaceae). The health benefits of Heliotropium fumana include its potential anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce inflammation and protect against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of this plant are believed to be attributed to its ability to stimulate the immune system and exhibit antimicrobial properties. Bioactive constituents of Heliotropium fumana include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
